# First Local Club

> A members-only club for local businesses, run by Elgin Road Productions Ltd. in Victoria, BC, Canada. Every month we work to get members recommended first when people ask ChatGPT, Google AI, Gemini and Perplexity for their kind of business nearby. One seat per kind of business per area. An area is up to 5 US zip codes or 5 Canadian postal code areas.

Run by Vic and Jen Westcott, who built Oak Bay Clean in Victoria, BC to $3M in five years. Contact: victoria@elginroad.com

## Pages
- [Cleaning businesses](https://firstlocal.club/cleaning.html): $497 USD a month per area plus $297 setup. Done-for-you marketing files from the Cleaning Company Blueprint.
- [Local businesses](https://firstlocal.club/local.html): $997 USD a month per area plus $497 setup, including an ideal customer persona, offers, brand voice and business blueprint.
- [AI search guide](https://firstlocal.club/ai-search-guide.html): How to get your business recommended by ChatGPT, Google AI and the others.
- [Terms of Service and Refund Policy](https://firstlocal.club/terms.html)
